aiOverview.content:
The Publix Guarantee states: "We will never knowingly disappoint you. If for any reason your purchase does not give you complete satisfaction, the full purchase price will be cheerfully refunded immediately upon request".
- Publix Guarantee: Established by founder George W. Jenkins, this covers product satisfaction with full refunds for opened or unopened items.
- The Publix Promise: Under the Publix Promise, if the scanned price of an item at checkout is higher than the shelf price or advertised price (excluding alcohol and tobacco), you get that first item free.
- Receipts & Refunds:
  - Having your receipt allows a full refund to your original payment method.
  - If you don't have the receipt, Publix can often look it up if you paid with a card or provided a phone number/Club Publix info.
  - Without a receipt or system match, a government-issued photo ID is required to process a return for a store gift card.
